title: v3 「코디세이로 오라」 별의 부름 컷 리스트 (한 컷 = 한 사람 대사)
look: Cinematic live-action Korean TV commercial, 35mm anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, dramatic rim lighting, deadpan comedic tone with a perfectly serious fantasy film-trailer look, natural skin texture, 16:9, no swords, no weapons, no glowing blades, no on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions, no logos, no watermark.

scenes.name: 별의 신호
scenes.set: on a rocky cliff above a sea of clouds under a vast starry night sky
scenes.key: Medium shot of {MASTER} on the cliff edge facing the camera, cloak flowing, stars behind her.

cuts.shot: Slow push-in from a wide shot of the cliff to a medium shot of {MASTER} facing the camera, cloak flowing in the wind.
lines: in a grand, slow, solemn voice

scenes.name: 국문과
scenes.set: on the grand stone steps of a university library at dusk, first stars appearing
scenes.key: {MASTER} at the top of the steps holding up the astrolabe, {SORA} at the bottom of the steps looking up.

cuts.shot: Low-angle medium shot of {MASTER} at the top of the steps, raising the brass astrolabe toward the camera.
High-angle medium close-up of {SORA} at the bottom of the steps, looking up and blinking.
Tight close-up of {MASTER}'s face, filling the frame.
action: she stays silent and slowly raises ONE eyebrow very high, an exaggerated, clearly visible comedic eyebrow raise, the rest of her face perfectly still

scenes.name: 빈 문틀
scenes.set: on the library steps, where a freestanding empty stone door frame faintly glowing with starlight stands, with no door in it
scenes.key: {SORA} stepping through the empty glowing door frame, {MASTER} standing beside it.

cuts.shot: Medium shot: {SORA} walks through the empty door frame, stops, and looks back at it, surprised.
Medium shot of {MASTER} standing beside the door frame, calm.
lines: flat, as if stating the obvious

scenes.name: 빈 지갑
scenes.set: beside a long bare concrete wall along an empty road at dawn, a few stars still in the sky
scenes.key: {DOHYUN} saluting beside the wall, {MASTER} facing him holding the astrolabe.

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {MASTER} beside the wall, the brass astrolabe glowing softly, pointing it toward the camera.
lines: in a grand, slow, mysterious voice

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {DOHYUN} standing by the wall, framed from the knees up so his hands are clearly visible.
action: he snaps a crisp military salute
he pulls out a brown leather wallet, opens it wide, and turns it upside down right in front of the camera; nothing falls out except a small grey puff of dust, clearly visible

cuts.shot: Close-up of {MASTER}. 0-1s: silence; then she nods once, flatly.

scenes.name: 장학금
scenes.set: beside the same concrete wall at dawn, tiny glowing golden stars drifting down from the sky like snow
scenes.key: {DOHYUN} holding out his open wallet as tiny glowing stars fall into it, {MASTER} beside him.

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {DOHYUN} holding out his open wallet as tiny glowing stars fall into it, astonished.
Medium close-up of {MASTER}, falling stars around her.

scenes.name: 월요일
scenes.set: in a dim late-night office on the 23rd floor of a city tower, fluorescent lights, with deep starry space outside the window instead of the city
scenes.key: {MINSEOK} at his desk in the dark office, and outside the window {MASTER} floating in starry space.

cuts.shot: Shot from inside the dark office looking at the big window. Outside the window, {MASTER} floats in mid-air in starry space, completely outside the building, separated from the office by the glass. Nobody else is in the office except an empty desk in the foreground.
lines: grand and solemn, slightly muffled through the glass
action: the Master raises the brass astrolabe and taps it twice on the outside of the glass, tap tap, clearly visible and audible

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {MINSEOK} at his desk, slowly turning only his head toward the window, exhausted.
action: he is hunched over his keyboard, then turns only his head toward the window, slowly, with an exhausted face

cuts.shot: Medium close-up of {MASTER} floating outside the office window in starry space, seen through the glass.
action: she gives a small reassuring nod and opens her free hand

scenes.name: 동료와 함께
scenes.set: on the office building rooftop at night under a starry sky, where several small groups of young people sit together around laptops under warm string lights, pointing at screens and helping each other
scenes.key: {MINSEOK} sitting on the rooftop edge looking discouraged, {MASTER} beside him gesturing toward groups of young people studying together around laptops behind them.

cuts.shot: Close-up of {MINSEOK} sitting alone on the rooftop edge, shoulders slumped.
action: he lets out a small tired sigh and looks down at his hands

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {MASTER} standing beside him; behind them, small groups of young people study together around laptops under string lights, clearly visible.
action: she turns and sweeps her open hand toward the groups of people studying together behind them

scenes.name: 동료
scenes.set: on a staircase of glowing stone steps floating in starry space
scenes.key: {SORA}, {DOHYUN} and {MINSEOK} meeting on the floating stairs, {MASTER} at the top.

cuts.shot: Medium shot of {MASTER} at the top of the stairs, calm.

scenes.name: 엔드카드
scenes.set: on a cliff edge under a sky full of bright constellations
scenes.key: Wide shot from behind of four people on the cliff facing the constellations: {MASTER}, {SORA}, {DOHYUN}, {MINSEOK}.

cuts.shot: Wide shot from behind of exactly four people on the cliff edge facing the constellations: {MASTER}, {SORA}, {DOHYUN} and {MINSEOK}. 0-2s: silence, only wind. Then the Master alone turns her head back over her shoulder toward the camera.
action: the Master alone turns her head back over her shoulder toward the camera with a solemn, intense look
